title: Capture integrated tree bytes after integrate for dependent jobs
acceptance: A job that depends on an earlier integrated run receives a snapshot of the integrated tree automatically.

title: Extract guard helpers from swarm.mjs into swarm-guard module
acceptance: swarm.mjs is split into guard, scope, run, integrate, board, spend, lanes and cli modules with no behavior change.

title: Extract spend and budgets commands into swarm-spend module
acceptance: swarm.mjs is split into guard, scope, run, integrate, board, spend, lanes and cli modules with no behavior change.

title: Tests modular swarm.mjs split and parallel module wave safety
acceptance: The full suite passes, and two queue items touching different modules can build in the same wave.

title: Reject or trim unprovable acceptance lines at split ingest
acceptance: scope split --ingest refuses a build ticket whose acceptance names files it does not write or own.
Copied requirement acceptance lines skip route-level checks until the integration ticket exists.

title: Add rename ticket type validation alongside migration checks
acceptance: validateTicket accepts a rename ticket with exactly one new file and one deletes entry.
A migration ticket still requires DDL-only files under supabase/migrations.

title: Wire honest base-check policy into swarm run base gate
acceptance: swarm run with checkBase refuses a stale red cache and prints the failing check tail.

title: Tests for local verify execution and cross-lane routing after tests pass
acceptance: verify mode "local" runs the ticket's tests itself with no agent and no tokens.
Tested tickets can then be built on any lane, including Cursor and Hermes.

title: Tests for adaptive worker limits and per-lane cap persistence
acceptance: The worker limit defaults from cores and free RAM, raises while CPU and RAM allow, and backs off on pressure or lane rate limits.
Learned per-lane caps are kept per machine.

title: Measure orchestrator transcript size against a configurable handoff threshold
acceptance: When an orchestrator's context passes a set size, it saves state to memory and a fresh session continues with no lost work.

title: Register licence and attribution checks on swarm validate and integrate
acceptance: swarm validate runs licence-product and attribution checks when data sources are declared.

title: Wire test cleanup and CI mirror helpers into swarm test commands
acceptance: swarm test cleanup runs the local e2e and database cleanup helpers from the project root.
